title: Independently replay the changed rational component and bind its helper owners
body:
Ali Romman's exact changed rational component independently passes all 1,289 rows each way and 5,700 first readers. The regenerated 48-call profile has 282,816 paid and 52,512 productive occurrences. Swapping two helper labels leaves the inherited sorted digests unchanged and is rejected by the ordered address-to-owner map.

At κ=0.003879929046155 rational has +3.452573399956609 signed units while unchanged BIT has about −0.000385127316614. The combined raw screen fails. The peer public component under d018f6ce89ba76b5ac0f56e1e23d73658d7f4681 and #7830 at 87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15 are pinned. Clean python3 -I -B verify.py passed twice with identity, digest and corrupted-byte controls. Credit Ali Romman and retained contributors. OpenAI Codex assisted.

## Open next questions

A profitable BIT component, fresh compiler, physical stock, precision and the outer application need separate requalification.
